text:
liam: Hey, after upgrading to @redwood/sdk-node v0.24.0 our calls to createSession now 404. Worked on 0.23.1, no code changes on our side. Any ideas?

maya: Sorry to hear that — can you paste a minimal repro, SDK version (exact), node version, and the raw error body/logs?

liam: node v18.16.0, SDK: 0.24.0 (pinned with ^0.24.0). Minimal repro:
```js
const Redwood = require('@redwood/sdk-node');
const client = new Redwood.Client({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.sessions.create({ name: 'test' });
```
Error we get:
```
HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":"route_not_found","path":"/sessions/create","hint":"did you mean /v1/sessions"}
```
Logs show POST to api.redwood.internal/sessions/create -> 404.

maya: thx. Can you curl the API directly (bypass SDK) so we can confirm server routes? Also include any X-Request-Id headers.

liam: curl -v:
```
POST /sessions/create HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.internal
Authorization: Bearer ***

< body >

* HTTP 404
* Server replied: {"error":"route_not_found","path":"/sessions/create"}
```
X-Request-Id: req_abc123

jordan: @maya ping from eng-sdk. This looks like a route template mismatch. In 0.24.0 we switched the default SDK route templates to the canonical /v1/* paths and (we thought) kept legacy aliases. Looks like the alias fallback was accidentally gated behind an env flag.

jordan: Quick check for you @liam — run:
```
node -e "console.log(require('@redwood/sdk-node/package.json').version)"
```
and also show process.env.NODE_ENV.

liam: version prints 0.24.0 and NODE_ENV=production on our CI runner.

jordan: ok that explains it. Bug: when NODE_ENV=production we disabled legacy aliasing to reduce accidental double-routing. That behavior should not have caused customer-visible 404s; fallback should have been opt-out, not opt-in.

maya: Workaround for now: set REDWOOD_LEGACY_ROUTE_FALLBACK=true in your environment or downgrade to @redwood/sdk-node@0.23.1. Can you try the env toggle and confirm?

liam: set REDWOOD_LEGACY_ROUTE_FALLBACK=true in our CI and re-ran — createSession now returns 200. Confirmed. Thanks.

olivia: FYI assigning to eng-sdk for a patch release. We need: 1) fix to restore alias fallback by default, 2) changelog + migration note, 3) highlight in support KB.

jordan: opened GH issue #4521 and a small PR that restores fallback for the next patch. CI passing. Tagging for 0.24.1 patch.

maya: I'll email liam with the temporary workaround and ETA for the patch (EOD).

deploy-bot: Published @redwood/sdk-node@0.24.1 -> patch includes default legacy fallback restored.

liam: installed 0.24.1 — tests pass, no env toggles needed. All good, thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
